# Assets

SVG and image assets for the GitHub profile README.

## Auto-Generated (by GitHub Actions)
| File | Generator | Schedule |
|------|-----------|----------|
| `stats-dashboard.svg` | `generate_stats.py` | Daily + on push |
| `github-contribution-grid-snake.svg` | Platane/snk | Daily at 12:00 UTC |
| `github-contribution-grid-snake-dark.svg` | Platane/snk | Daily at 12:00 UTC |

## Script-Generated (manual)
| File | Generator |
|------|-----------|
| `core-connectivity-v4.svg` | `build_connectivity.py` |
| `card-*.svg` | `build_connectivity.py` |
| `separator.svg` | `generate_separator.py` |

## Manually Created
- `banner-web-once.svg` - Animated neural web banner
- `operator-profile-hud.svg` - VisionOS HUD profile panel
- `system-stack.svg` - Animated skill icons stack
- `space-portfolio.svg` - Space portfolio project card
- `ai-video-restoration.svg` - AI video restoration card
- `ai-portfolio-maker.svg` - Portfolio maker project card
- `apis.svg` - APIS academic system card
